title.narrative: Emergency Assistance in response to crisis in CAR (EA05/2014)

description.narrative:
This is a solidarity grant to Caritas Central African Republic's CI Emergency Appeal, responding to the continuing instability in CAR. The political instability that began with the rise of the Seleka rebel group and coup in December 2012/13 is ongoing. Most recently an interim president has taken over, however, intercommunal tensions and violence still continues. This fighting has caused massive displacement, looting and the destruction of public services and provisions.
Following the widespread destruction of property and livelihoods, and the collapse of basic services, the EA 2014 aims to restore basic living conditions in the operational areas of Caritas CAR. The programme aims to improve the daily lives of people affected by the conflict, by responding to the most critical needs and providing better access to a range of essential services. For all the selected sectors, the most vulnerable will be targeted. The multi-sector, year-long programme will be focusing on:
• Food security: the programme will ensure greater food security through the provision of agricultural inputs such as seeds and tools, and well as training in agricultural techniques.
• Health: the programme will address community health problems through the reconstruction of medical buildings (health centers, hospitals) and capacity building support to health care professionals.
• Shelter: Due to the large number of houses that have been destroyed (burned/looted), shelter/NFI kits will be provided to help rebuild damaged or destroyed homes.
• Education: School kits will be provided to orphans and other vulnerable children; parent groups will be formed or supported; education initiatives to improve school attendance and completion.
• Peace Building: Local groups of young peacemakers will be created, to mitigate communal conflicts through dialogue and cooperation. Religious leaders will be supported to advocate for peace at a national level.
